note: Sneak mode, finished: sneaking now fools monsters as well as people — a creature only notices you within 12 paces while you sneak (down from 24), and a beast already chasing you does not lose you just because you duck into the shadows. While sneaking your figure visibly dims so you can see at a glance that you are hidden. Folk you have alerted now remember it through save and reload — no more getting forgiven by quitting — and a first strike from the shadows now also hits twice as hard against wandering adventurers and travelers, not just villagers.
